যৌন শোষণ, নির্যাতন, হয়রানি, বৈষম্য এবং অন্যান্য যেকোনো ধরনের অসদাচরণের বিরুদ্ধে আরণ্যক ফাউন্ডেশনের শূন্য-সহনশীলতা নীতি (Zero Tolerance Policy) রয়েছে।
সকলের জন্য একটি নিরাপদ ও সম্মানজনক কর্মপরিবেশ নিশ্চিত করতে আমরা প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ।
আরণ্যক ফাউন্ডেশনের সঙ্গে সংশ্লিষ্ট, প্রতিষ্ঠানে কর্মরত অথবা প্রতিষ্ঠানের প্রতিনিধিত্বকারী প্রত্যেক ব্যক্তিকে ফাউন্ডেশনের সেফগার্ডিং নীতিমালা, আচরণবিধি (Code of Conduct) এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট অন্যান্য মানদণ্ড অনুসরণ করতে হবে। এসব নীতি ও মূল্যবোধের প্রতি প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ প্রার্থীদেরই নিয়োগের জন্য বিবেচনা করা হবে।
নিয়োগ ও নির্বাচন প্রক্রিয়ার অংশ হিসেবে সন্তোষজনক রেফারেন্স যাচাই এবং প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে যথাযথ সেফগার্ডিং স্ক্রিনিং সম্পন্ন করা হবে।

আবেদন ও নিয়োগসংক্রান্ত তথ্য:
আবেদনের শেষ তারিখ: ১৩ নভেম্বর ২০২৬, রাত ১১টা ৫৯ মিনিট (বাংলাদেশ সময়)।
বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য: আরণ্যক ফাউন্ডেশন যেকোনো আবেদন বাতিল করার এবং যেকোনো পর্যায়ে কোনো কারণ ব্যাখ্যা ছাড়াই সম্পূর্ণ নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া পরিবর্তন বা বাতিল করার অধিকার সংরক্ষণ করে।

পদের বিস্তারিত বিবরণ দেখতে এবং অনলাইনে আবেদন জমা দিতে নিচের লিংকে ক্লিক করুন।

Employment Type	: Project-based / Contractual Duration : 15 October 2026 to 30 September 2028 Reporting To : Project Coordinator 1. Position Summary JAGO NARI is a non-governmental development organization working in the central coastal region of Bangladesh. The organization focuses on women's empowerment, Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Health and Nutrition, Food Security and Livelihood, and Education. JAGO NARI works to promote gender equality, community resilience, sustainable development and the rights of vulnerable and marginalized communities. JAGO NARI is going to implement the project titled "She Leads the Shore: Women's Climate Justice and Recovery in Coastal Bhola District of Bangladesh" with technical support from UN Women. The project aims to strengthen women's leadership in local climate governance and peace building, promote climate-smart and nature-based livelihoods for women and young women, and enhance gender-responsive knowledge, dialogue and community advocacy to promote inclusion, social cohesion and peace. In this context, JAGO NARI is seeking qualified, committed and dynamic candidates for the position of Union Facilitator to support effective implementation of project activities at the union and community levels. The Union Facilitator will serve as a frontline project representative and will be responsible for facilitating, coordinating and monitoring project activities at the union and community levels. The position will play a critical role in mobilizing women, young women, Fisherfolk and other vulnerable community members to strengthen their leadership, participation and decision-making in local climate governance, disaster risk reduction, peace building and livelihood development. Key Responsibilities and Duties: A. Project Implementation and Community Mobilization Facilitate the implementation of project activities at the union and community levels in accordance with the approved project proposal, work plan, budget and implementation guidelines. Conduct regular community visits to ensure effective implementation, follow-up and monitoring of project activities. Mobilize women, young women, Fisherfolk, youth and other vulnerable groups to participate actively in project interventions. Identify and engage marginalized and climate-vulnerable women, including women from Fisherfolk communities, women-headed households and economically disadvantaged groups. Establish and maintain effective relationships with community leaders, local government representatives, community-based organizations and other relevant stakeholders. Facilitate community meetings, group discussions, awareness sessions, workshops and other project-related events. Ensure meaningful participation of women and young women in all stages of project implementation. Support the development and maintenance of community groups and networks to promote collective action and local leadership. B. Climate Vulnerability Assessment and Participatory Mapping Conduct participatory climate-livelihood vulnerability and opportunity mapping with women’s groups, including Fisherfolk and other climate-vulnerable communities. Facilitate community-based risk and vulnerability assessments to identify climate-related hazards, exposure, vulnerabilities, capacities and available resources. Facilitate participatory resource mapping to identify available livelihood opportunities, natural resources and potential areas of resource-related conflict. C. Establishment and Strengthening of Women's Climate Peace Committees (WCPCs) Facilitate the formation of Union-level Women's Climate Peace Committees (WCPCs) in accordance with project guidelines. Ensure inclusive representation of women, young women, Fisherfolk and marginalized communities in the committees. Organize regular meetings of WCPCs and facilitate participatory discussions on climate justice, women's rights, disaster preparedness, recovery and peace building. Strengthen the leadership, negotiation, advocacy, communication and conflict-resolution capacities of WCPC members. Facilitate linkages between WCPCs and Union Parishads, Ward Disaster Management Committees (WDMCs), Union Disaster Management Committees (UDMCs) and other relevant institutions. D. Women's Leadership, Advocacy and Local Climate Governance Organize quarterly sessions for project participants on human rights, women's rights, climate justice, advocacy, negotiation and leadership development. Facilitate quarterly interface meetings between WCPCs and Union Parishads/local disaster management committees to ensure women's voices are reflected in local disaster response, climate adaptation and recovery plans. E. Training, Capacity Development and Awareness Rising Identify training and capacity development needs of women, young women, WCPC members, community groups and local institutions. Organize and facilitate different types of community-level training, orientation sessions, workshops and awareness-raising activities. Support the delivery of training on climate change adaptation, DRR, climate justice, gender equality, women's leadership, human rights, peace building and livelihood development. F. Climate-Smart and Nature-Based Livelihood Development Support the identification and promotion of climate-smart and nature-based livelihood opportunities for women and young women. Facilitate the selection and organization of women entrepreneurs and livelihood groups based on project criteria.
